agent.name: Emerging Technology Landscape Agent
agent.specialty: Dated competitive landscape and reassessment triggers

general_et_finding: 2026-11-16 | Standardized identifier syntax; deployment is workflow-specific. A phone can open a web link, while a checkout must interpret the identifier. GS1’s 2027 ambition does not measure installed compatibility. No independent market-share or unit-cost measurements in the register.
confidence_and_uncertainty: High confidence in the distinction between syntax and deployment; low confidence in incremental value or partner readiness without local measurements.
analytical_question: Can the next wholesale print run omit the existing UPC/EAN barcode?
application_finding: Investigate. Compare QR-only with the existing UPC/EAN. A web page opening is irrelevant if a lane cannot ring the correct SKU once, offline as well as online.
organization_specific_finding: Multiple lane configurations, no partner acceptance letter or test logs, and a costly print commitment make the existing linear code the stronger control.

evidence.claim: Defines how a product identifier can appear in a web address. Extracting identifiers requires software that understands the syntax.
evidence.source_or_reference: S1 GS1 | Digital Link URI syntax 1.7.0 https://ref.gs1.org/standards/digital-link/uri-syntax/1.7.0/
evidence.notes: Proves a specification exists; no installed-base or cost estimate.

evidence.claim: End-2027 is a capability ambition. A transition may require software or scanner upgrades.
evidence.source_or_reference: S2 GS1 | 2D Barcodes at Retail POS, release 1.1, §1.2 https://ref.gs1.org/guidelines/2d-in-retail/1.1.0/GS1-2DRetailPOS-Guideline-i1.1-r-2025-12-15
evidence.notes: Same issuer as S1; does not independently corroborate adoption.

evidence.claim: The FAQ distinguishes its DataMatrix implementation from QR acceptance. It illustrates why the exact carrier matters.
evidence.source_or_reference: S4 Woolworths Partner Hub | GS1 DataMatrix supplier FAQs https://assets.ctfassets.net/9uypwcnuzbqi/dc4uwitNGJnYDp7Tph1EH/56ac26b6afa59391f9e01f6a85ab52c6/GS1au-Datamatrix-woolworths-reference-guide.pdf
evidence.evidence_type: Operator/supplier guidance; produced with GS1 Australia
evidence.notes: Historical example only. Publication date unknown; cannot establish current Woolworths status or this partner’s policy.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: The undated Woolworths document concerns another operator and differentiates DataMatrix from QR; it is not current evidence about this apparel partner.
A target date and a device specification cannot substitute for lane results.

Three reports repeating one release count as one vendor assertion and provide zero additional independent confirmations. The 2027 ambition is especially vulnerable to being repeated as present readiness.
value_opportunity_implication: Removing a symbol might free tag space. Compare that benefit with relabeling and checkout exception costs before a print change.
risk_governance_implication: Partner POS owner must confirm processing and cashier fallback; preserve the working barcode.
recommendation_management_implication: Hold QR-only printing. Retain UPC/EAN and request partner evidence; a dual-marked sandbox tag may be used for testing.
change_monitoring_triggers: Partner manager checks monthly and before print lock for dated written acceptance of QR with GS1 Digital Link for the named products and lanes. On receipt, schedule controlled lane testing; otherwise keep UPC/EAN.

POS lead tests each target lane configuration, online/offline, sale and return, against UPC/EAN before print lock. Require correct item and single posting in every scripted test. Missing configuration or any error: retain linear code. A full pass opens a limited pilot review only.
Repeat after scanner firmware or POS software changes. Commercial owner withholds artwork release until dated partner evidence is attached.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Withhold any QR-only rollout verdict until partner coverage, failure costs and representative live results are available. Pass conditions are proposed gates.
